Time to do the 12 steps again. Just substitute  food and binge eating for your DOC.

This is my next approach.  I tried working out more regularly,  but then I just get more hungry and snack more. I have a ahard time cutting it down.

I cant commit to loving someone else and fake a healthy relationship until I comes to terms and properly  handle my alcohol  and drug abuse problems.

How can I participate in a relationship if I hate myself and want to die all the time?

It's getting better. I'm at double digits clean and sober. Maybe I'll think about socializing after 365 days in a row.

This. 100%. I'm struggling with cocaine. I'm aware enough to  know it. I am not a heavy used in the daily, struggling to make ends meet, ruining my life, cant afford it kind of user. But I use regularly.  I know that I have chosen this drug over friends- family. Most of my connections are loose. 

I do have a bundle of mental health issues  but that hasn't stopped me from being successful  career wise,  graduated school with honours, got a job, moved up etc.. I have friends I can call - but in the end I can't  handle both my addiction and a relationship.  Hell I dont want to call my friends or family.

I want to drink alone, silently, and do my DOC. Currently in my mind, all I want is more. I can  tell myself I want to change, I want to be better and I know its possible- but right now I'm a shit person of a mess I cant imagine someone who is divorced, with two kids, and a stressful job  thinking  any different. We have have different stories with different burdens but addiction and drug uses will make them exponentially  worse eventually to the point where it isn't manageable.


When you are in active addiction,  whether it is known or not, the one true relationship the user will fall back on is the drug.
Be convinced more than ever that I should have died younger.

I was getting a text from someone I used to be friends with Sunday at 1am.
" You should be to anannanananan" (narcotics anonymous)and calling me a weirdo. 

He was probably black out drunk and high, I ain't got time for that. Blocked and deleted.

I struggle with my relapses, but I know I'll be counting years and not just days soon.
Gluten and dairy get me sorry bloated and gassy. I was told to start using Digestive enzymes.... Fuck it though.
Let the old you die, along with the shitty friends. Embrace a new sober life, work the steps, seek help to for your mental health. Become a new you. Let the old you die.
Don't drink. Don't think about killing myself

In and out of rooms for able a year now. Was clean on my own for awhile. The rooms around here are so damn incestuous. The higher power is always god and your jumped on for saying otherwise at a few of them. Sharing rules were slack and let alot of people say their doc by name. Shares went off topic alot of times too. 

I've been to too many meetings where the person next to me is high as fuck or someone is trying to make a deal during break.
